voltageValue.description: Shows the voltage value of this cell.

cellBalance.description: Shows whether the cell balance is active for this cell or not.

functionStatus.description: Shows the function status of this cell.

safetyStatus.description: Shows the safety status of this cell.

entries.description:
`position` shows entries order as some of the time-windows are reserved e.g. the fourth time-window is being used for DHW legionella-protection for some devices (e.g. Vitotronic).

`overlapAllowed` shows if time-windows can overlap each other. The window with the higher temperature takes precedence over another if allowed (e.g. Vitotronic).

status.description: Shows the status of the filter
